summary: CVE-2026-93520 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A heap buffer overflow caused by mismatching size calculations between XkbAllocNames and  ChangeKeycodeRange in X.org X server before 2.1.25 and XWayland before 24.1.14 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash or potentially execute code in X server context.
